    Remote · Contractor · Full-time, 8 AM–5 PM PST

     

    Lime Vizio runs 6 eCommerce brands for flowers and gifts in the US & Canada (Blossom Flower Delivery, Flowers in 4 Hours, Gift Basket Universe and others). We process ~2,000 orders per day, up to 2,000 per hour at peak season. Our customers buy with emotion: birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, Mother's Day. Our storefronts need to feel warm, rich and beautiful, not just work.

     

    We're looking for a designer with a strong, emotional visual sense, top-level Figma skills and a solid grasp of how eCommerce flows work.

     

    What you'll do

    • Create and refresh site visuals: homepage, category and product pages, promo blocks
    • Design seasonal campaigns (Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas): banners, landing pages, email visuals
    • Produce custom imagery with AI tools (floral compositions, backgrounds, lifestyle scenes), then refine it until it looks like ours rather than like AI
    • Proactively suggest ways to make the site more beautiful and more emotional
    • Build and maintain clean, scalable Figma files and components across multiple brands

    • Design with the full purchase flow in mind: how a visual change affects navigation, product choice and checkout

       

    Our visual direction

    Soft, premium, emotional: greys, soft pink and nude tones, elegant typography, floral imagery that feels real, warm and alive.

     

    What we're not looking for:

    • Trendy minimalism that strips away emotion
    • Flat, purely "functional" UI that looks like a SaaS dashboard

    • Generic AI imagery used straight out of the generator

       

    What we're looking for

    • 3+ years in UI / visual / web design, ideally eCommerce, lifestyle, beauty, fashion or gifting
    • A portfolio with distinctive aesthetics and emotional, detailed visual work: we hire on taste first
    • Advanced AI image skills: iterating and rewriting prompts, combining outputs, compositing, retouching and color-matching in Photoshop until the result fits the brand (e.g. Midjourney, Firefly, Photoshop Generative Fill)
    • Figma at a high level: auto layout, variants, components, organized files, developer-ready handoff
    • Understanding of eCommerce logic: user flows, product → cart → checkout, and how design decisions affect conversion
    • Speed and reliability, especially before peak seasons
    • Availability to work full-time 8 AM–5 PM PST

    • English B2+

       

    Nice to have

    • Email design
    • Motion / animated banners

    • Basic HTML/CSS

       

    What we offer

    • Your work goes live fast and is seen by real customers across 6 brands
    • Creative ownership of how our storefronts look
    • A fast-moving product team with a short decision chain

    Performa is an international HR agency specializing in connecting top talent with leading companies across the iGaming, IT, and Marketing industries.

    Our client is an iGaming company launching a new online crypto casino project as a spin-off from a large international casino brand. The project is currently at an early stage, with a core team already in place and active preparation for launch.

     

    We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join the team and work closely with the Group CFO, taking ownership of financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, financial performance analysis, and investment evaluation across the online casino and the group's AI startup ventures. The role involves assessing business performance, analysing unit economics, evaluating new projects and investment opportunities, and providing data-driven recommendations to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.

     

    ABOUT THE ROLE

    You will be the Group CFO’s analytical right hand for the online casino and for the group’s AI start-up projects. The online casino has no project-level CFO: the Group CFO leads its finance directly, and this role takes over the budgeting, modelling and analysis previously handled by the project CFO.

    This is a decision-support role, not an accounting one. You will assess budgets before they are approved, build and maintain the financial models, and turn platform and finance data into a clear view of what is working. Payments, treasury and accounting remain with FinOps and the Financial Controller.

    One part of the work is the online casino: deposits, GGR, bonus cost, payment fees, and player acquisition and retention economics. The other is evaluating and modelling the AI start-ups the group builds or invests in: unit economics, burn, runway, and whether a project merits funding.

     

    KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Budgets and planning

    • Review and challenge budgets submitted by Operations, Marketing, IT and the AI project teams before the Group CFO approves them.
    • Own the annual budget and rolling forecast for the online casino; reconcile plan to actual every month and explain the variances.

    • Assess the economics of marketing campaigns, bonus programmes and affiliate deals before funds are committed.

       

    Financial modelling

    • Own the online casino operating model: deposits, GGR and NGR, bonus cost, payment and provider fees, CAC, LTV, payback, headcount and cash flow.
    • Build models for the AI start-ups from scratch: revenue logic, unit economics, compute and team costs, burn and runway, scenario and sensitivity analysis.

    • Keep models auditable and reusable by others: explicit assumptions, documented drivers and no hard-coded numbers.

       

    Analysis and reporting

    • Analyse online casino platform and finance data by cohort, channel, market and product to show where margin is created and where it is lost.
    • Prepare the monthly management report and KPI dashboard for the Group CFO and Group CEO.

    • Answer ad hoc questions with numbers and a clear recommendation.

       

    Project evaluation and strategy

    • Evaluate new projects, markets and investments: business case, NPV/IRR or payback, key risks and a go/no-go recommendation.

    • Support the Group CFO with materials for investors, the board and partners.

       

    REQUIREMENTS

    Experience

    • 4–7 years in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis or strategy.
    • Background in digital businesses built on unit economics: iGaming, fintech, marketplaces, SaaS, e-commerce or consumer apps.
    • Experience in the crypto industry or with crypto assets, and a working understanding of its infrastructure: blockchains and networks, wallets and custody, exchanges and OTC desks, crypto PSPs, stablecoins, and fiat on- and off-ramps.
    • A proven record of building three-statement and driver-based financial models from a blank sheet.
    • Hands-on project and investment evaluation: business cases, DCF, NPV/IRR, payback, scenario and sensitivity analysis.

    • Budgeting and plan-versus-actual analysis alongside business teams, including the confidence to challenge weak assumptions.

       

    Skills

    • Strong command of unit economics: CAC, LTV, cohort retention, contribution margin and payback.
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; SQL to pull and validate data independently.
    • Hands-on blockchain skills: reading on-chain transactions in block explorers, reconciling wallet movements to ledger records, and understanding network fees and confirmations.
    • Ability to explain a conclusion to a non-finance audience on one page or in five minutes.

    • Autonomy: the Group CFO sets the question, and you own the analysis end to end.

       

    Education

    • Preferred: a technical first degree (mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science or similar) plus additional finance education, such as an MSc in Finance, an MBA, the CFA or ACCA (in progress or completed).

    • A finance or economics degree is also considered, provided it comes with proven quantitative and data skills.

       

    NICE TO HAVE

    • Strategy experience in fintech or another technology company: market sizing, market-entry decisions, pricing and competitive benchmarking.
    • Familiarity with iGaming: GGR/NGR logic, bonus economics and PSP fees.
    • Experience with early-stage start-ups or venture investing, ideally in AI or software products whose costs scale with usage and compute.
    • Training in consulting, investment banking or Big Four transaction services.

    ABOUT THE ROLE

    We are hiring a Controls & Firmware Engineer to make the system move with the person wearing it. You will own everything that runs on the device: the low-level firmware, the control algorithm that decides how much assistance to give and when, and the full pipeline that trains it, from data collection to model deployment. You will take over firmware and controls with a hands-on handover from the current team in the first weeks, and from then on you are the lead, sitting next to the units and the soldiers who use them. 

     

    You will report to our Engineering Lead and work every day with the software engineer and the field team. This is a lead role: you decide, ship and take responsibility for what is on the device. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and make

    decisions on your own.

     

    WHAT YOU WILL DO

    • Make the system feel right in every situation a soldier is in, on the move and under load

    • Improve our machine-learning controls, retrain them with new data, and ship a release every week with notes on what

    changed and how to test it

    • Write and maintain the embedded firmware: motor control over CAN, IMU and sensor reading, fault handling, battery

    and thermal limits, logging, Bluetooth to the app, over-the-air and USB updates

    • Put reliability first: a unit in the field must never do something unexpected to the person wearing it

    • Run data collection in Kyiv with new test subjects every week, and make the collect, label, train, release loop fast

    • Own the full data-to-model-to-firmware pipeline: the training server, training infrastructure, dataset management and

    model deployment

    • Take over our motor driver firmware, test it, make it reliable and own it going forward

    • Support the field: flash and update units, read logs from tests, and turn what soldiers say into the next release

    • Take ownership and make fast, practical decisions without waiting for detailed direction

     

    WHAT YOU BRING

    • Has shipped firmware on a robot, drone, prosthetic, powered wearable or similar: a real device with motors, sensors

    and a battery, used by people

    • Strong in embedded C on a microcontroller (ESP32 or similar), motor control, CAN, IMUs and real-time loops, and

    comfortable with a scope and a soldering iron
